intro.text: Daora's son and Kiin's stepson, a young man of Kae who studied at a Svordish university and is married to Jalla.
Kiin's stepson, one of Kae's most successful merchants, with a standing welcome at court, and a devoted friend of Prince Raoden.
Kiin's stepson, a prosperous Kae merchant and devoted friend of Prince Raoden, who belongs to the circle of nobles opposing King Iadon's rule.

items.text: Lukel is Daora's son by an earlier husband. When she married Kiin, he adopted Lukel and Lukel's brother Adien and took on the full role of their father.
Lukel studied at a Svordish university, where he met Jalla; the two are now married.

Lukel belonged to the nobles Raoden had rallied against King Iadon's policies. With Raoden gone, he kept going to their shrinking meetings, told Sarene about them and helped her win a place there, urging care but agreeing they should keep planning.
Lukel came along to watch Sarene teach the court women to fence, teasing her as always while cheering her on.

For the group's plan to change Iadon's policies, Lukel followed the king's income closely, and he confirmed that Iadon had only scraped by thanks to his trade in Teod and some taxes. Lukel also closed a highly profitable deal of his own.

Lukel stayed with the group's planning after King Iadon's death, and was still part of it when Sarene came back to Kiin's house to plan how to stand against the Derethi now that Telrii held the throne.
Once Raoden was back in Kae, Lukel knelt to him straight away as the true king and agreed to the plan to do so in public as well.
When Dakhor monks attacked Kae, Lukel and Kiin rescued Sarene from one of them.

Lukel looked after Daora and the children in the cellar as the attack began. The family were taken and driven through the city with Kae's other prisoners toward Elantris to be burned; at first Lukel did not resist, only holding his family close.

When Shuden started to fight, Lukel joined in with a table leg, surviving by running and hiding, with help from Sarene's fencing students. A soldier slashed his thigh and left him; Jalla hauled him back among the captives and tried to stop the bleeding. Seeing that Elantris was restored, he fainted, and after the fighting Raoden healed him.

appearance.text: Lukel is of ordinary Arelene height and lean, with a strikingly handsome, hawk-like face and hair parted in the middle and falling to either side. He dresses fashionably, for example in a blue vest stitched with gold and tan trousers.

personality.text: Lukel loves his family dearly and is always joking, constantly teasing his relatives and friends.
A gifted merchant, Lukel ranks among the city's most successful traders, which earns him an open invitation to court.
A good deal leaves Lukel proud and cheerful, and even more full of jokes than usual.

items.text: Lukel and Raoden are best friends. After the Shaod took him, Raoden was sorry he would never come to know Lukel's wife or any children they might have.
Lukel calls Raoden the greatest man he has ever known.

Lukel and Sarene quickly grow fond of each other. He teases her, not least about her painting, and is among the first to explain Arelon's politics to her: how land was taken, how servants came close to being property and how Iadon won the throne. He also gets her into the meetings of Raoden's most loyal supporters.

Lukel married Jalla, a Svordish woman he met at school, a month before Sarene came to Arelon. A fierce bargainer, she helps with his trading, and he calls her both brilliant and beautiful. As they were driven toward Elantris he urged her to use her Svordish birth to bargain her way free, but she would not abandon them.
